workflow: Two-factor authentication (2FA) is an extra layer of security that requires two methods of verification to log into an account. It combines something you know (such as a password) with something you have (something physical, like a phone or an authentication key). When 2FA is set up, a user will be asked to enter their username and password, then a unique code will be sent via text message or generated by an authentication app to their device.
